title: The Cellar
description: Day 288. A solar storm puts the Loire's four caretakers in the shelter for thirty-one hours, and what they carry out with them is not what they carried in.
scenario: Day 288 of the Loire's long leg home, seventy-six days after the slip-ring repair. An X-class flare has thrown a storm of protons at the ship, and the crew have thirty-seven minutes to reach the Cellar, the water-walled shelter at the heart of the Hub, and stay there until the Sun is finished with them. Four people, one cold room, no gravity, and a daughter on Mars in the path of the same storm.
